Before the commencement of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) 2026, the electoral roll comprised 516,427 electors. The Draft Electoral Roll was published on 21.07.2026, containing 450,282 electors. The draft roll includes only those electors who submitted their Enumeration Forms during the SIR process and whose particulars were found eligible for inclusion in accordance with the prescribed guidelines. Consequently, the number of electors in the Draft Electoral Roll declined by approximately 12.8% compared to the pre-SIR electoral roll.
The publication of the Draft Electoral Roll is only an intermediate stage of the revision process. Any eligible person whose name is not included in the draft roll may apply for inclusion by submitting Form-6, along with the prescribed supporting documents, during the claims and objections period. Upon due verification and approval by the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO), the names of all eligible applicants shall be included in the Final Electoral Roll.
Throughout the Special Intensive Revision, representatives of all recognized political parties were regularly informed of every stage of the revision process through meetings and consultations. A total of 1,780 Booth Level Agents (BLAs) were appointed by the recognized political parties, and they actively participated throughout the revision process. In compliance with the instructions of the Election Commission of India, the lists of additions and deletions were updated regularly and shared with all recognized political parties on a weekly basis in the prescribed statutory formats, namely Form-9, Form-10, Form-11, Form-11A, and Form-11B, thereby ensuring transparency and facilitating continuous verification by the political parties. During these meetings, representatives of the recognized political parties were afforded adequate opportunity to raise any issues, concerns, or objections relating to the revision process. However, no substantive issue, grievance, or objection was raised by any political party during such meetings.
